messages:
mira: Observability flagged the canary that persisted short request snippets. Security wants no freeform text in ledger. We need a triage path that keeps support efficient without durable PII.

sam: Agreed. Minimal ledger + ephemeral fetch seems right. Sketch: ledger stores fingerprint + pointer + single-use redeem_token_kid. Ephemeral store holds encrypted blob TTL=2h. Redeem flow enforces RBAC+MFA and writes an immutable audit row.

elaine: Two policy constraints: (1) Per-tenant write/redeem quotas to prevent abuse and cost spikes. (2) Default behavior for EU tenants: auto-delete on DSAR. Also redact high-entropy tokens before storing.

jorge: UX: keep one-click "Request Inspect" but require explicit modal ack and show requester identity + reason. Show a countdown and a notice: "Copying is audited." Make token single-use and surface redeem_count in activity stream.

sam: Implementation notes: add nonce before hashing so identical requests don't correlate across tenants. Token = compact signed JWT {kid, ptr, exp, single_use:true}. Redeem endpoint atomically marks token used and returns blob if permitted.

mira: Audit rows must include redeemer, IP, console_session, reason, and token_kid. Store audits in WORM storage with configurable retention.

elaine: Quota enforcement: write_quota and redeem_quota per-tenant. Return 429 with metric inspect.quota.blocked. Also expose soft-throttle which returns 202 and queues decrypt if tenant allows delayed triage.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: starting canary telemetry-ephemeral-v1 us-west-2.

sam: Rollout plan: org opt-in pilot (5 tenants) -> 2-week telemetry -> expand to 50 -> default off for hosted. Metrics: inspect.blob.write, inspect.redeem.success, inspect.redeem.denied, inspect.quota.exceeded. SLI: 95% redeems <1s.

jorge: UX nit: prevent copy out by greying copy button unless user has "export" permission. Add a small checkbox: "I will not copy sensitive data."

mira: Action items: Sam PR for ledger + redeem API + metrics. Elaine quota + DSAR playbook + load sim. Jorge UI modal + export perms. Ops key rotation + infra. I'll open RFC and schedule 30m sync tomorrow.

sam: I'll start the PR and add unit tests for single-use path.

elaine: I'll run a 48h cost sim for ephemeral store and KMS ops and post numbers.

mira: Thanks — pinning checklist and tagging infra/ops. :thumbsup:
